descriptions.gelsenkirchen_veltins_arena: Home of FC Schalke 04 in Gelsenkirchen. One of the most modern stadiums in Europe, with a retractable pitch. The guided Arena Tour covers the dressing rooms, the tunnel, the stadium chapel and admission to the Schalke Museum. Note: tours suspended 5-13 Oct 2026.
descriptions.gelsenkirchen_zoom_erlebniswelt: An award-winning next-generation zoo with immersive themed worlds: Alaska, Africa and Asia.
descriptions.gelsenkirchen_nordsternpark: The revitalised site of the former Zeche Nordstern coal mine, turned into a landscape park with Markus Lüpertz's Hercules sculpture on top of the winding tower.
descriptions.essen_zeche_zollverein: An icon of the Industrial Heritage Trail and a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The mine and coking plant grounds are free to enter; the price below is for the paid guided tour (1 h). The Ruhr Museum and the Red Dot Design Museum have separate tickets.
descriptions.dortmund_signal_iduna_park: The largest football stadium in Germany (81,000 seats), home of Borussia Dortmund with its famous Yellow Wall (Südtribüne). The price is for the standard 90-minute guided Stadiontour; the shorter 'Triff Emma' tour (60 min) costs 15 EUR.
descriptions.dortmund_fussballmuseum: The official German Football Museum (DFB) right next to Dortmund main station. The World Cup trophy, the history of the Bundesliga and interactive game zones.
descriptions.berlin_olympiastadion: The legendary 1936 Olympic stadium, home of Hertha BSC and venue of the DFB-Pokal finals and the European Championship. Self-guided visit (Besichtigung); multimedia guide for an extra fee.
descriptions.berlin_alte_foersterei: The iconic forest stadium of 1. FC Union Berlin in the Köpenick district, built largely by the club's own fans.
descriptions.berlin_museumsinsel: A world-famous complex of 5 UNESCO museums in the heart of Berlin (including the Neues Museum with the famous bust of Nefertiti and the Altes Museum). The price is the 'Bereichskarte Museumsinsel' day ticket for all museums on the island. The Pergamonmuseum is closed until July 2027.
descriptions.berlin_fernsehturm: The tallest structure in Germany (368 m) at Alexanderplatz. An observation deck at 203 metres with a 360-degree view over the whole of Berlin. The price is the 'Standard Ticket' (queue-free entry included); the 'View & DRINK' option with a drink starts at 31 EUR. The Berlin WelcomeCard discount (25% on the observation ticket) is honoured only at the box office on site, not online.
descriptions.berlin_brandenburger_tor: A symbol of German unification and a neoclassical gate with a quadriga, right next to the glass dome of the Reichstag. The gate itself and the Reichstag dome are free, but visiting the dome requires mandatory online registration in advance (bundestag.de).
descriptions.berlin_curry36: The legendary Berlin sausage with curry sauce in Kreuzberg, served for generations next to the famous Mustafa's kebab. Indicative price (Currywurst + Pommes separately, no formal 'combo' on the menu).
descriptions.krakow_wawel: The historic seat of the Polish kings. The price is for the 'State Rooms' route (individual ticket, also includes the Turkish Tents exhibition and, seasonally, the Royal Gardens). The castle sells several separate tickets for different routes (Crown Treasury, Private Apartments, Armoury, Lost Wawel) in a similar price range (47/35 PLN) - this is NOT one combined ticket. Entry to the castle courtyard/hill is free.
descriptions.krakow_katedra_wawelska: The cathedral on Wawel Hill with the Sigismund Bell, the royal crypts and tombs, and the Cathedral Museum. Run by the Archdiocese of Kraków, INDEPENDENTLY of the Royal Castle - a separate ticket, a different operator and a different box office.
descriptions.krakow_schindler_factory: The world-famous exhibition 'Kraków - time of occupation 1939-1945' in the former enamel factory.
descriptions.krakow_stadion_wisly: Home of 13-time Polish champions Wisła Kraków. A tour of the stadium, VIP areas and the club museum 'Wisła z tradycją'. The tour offer may be inactive - it is worth checking with the club.
descriptions.krakow_kazimierz_zapiekanki: Traditional crispy zapiekanki with mushrooms and cheese on Plac Nowy in the historic Jewish district of Kazimierz. Indicative price - street food with no formal online price list.
descriptions.lublin_arena_lublin: A modern football stadium of Motor Lublin (15,500 seats), which hosted the FIFA U-20 World Cup, among other events. The price is for the seasonal (July-August) guided tour, not a match ticket.
descriptions.lublin_zamek_muzeum: A castle with a Romanesque keep and the priceless Chapel of the Holy Trinity with 14th-century Ruthenian-Byzantine frescoes. The price is for the combined ticket (permanent exhibitions + Chapel + tower); the Chapel alone costs 20 PLN separately.
descriptions.lublin_majdanek: A memorial and museum on the site of the former German concentration and extermination camp. Entry to the grounds and the permanent exhibitions is free. Only guided tours on weekends are paid (25 PLN regular / 20 PLN reduced ticket, Saturdays and Sundays at 11:00 and 14:15).
descriptions.lublin_cebularz: An interactive show and workshop on baking the famous Lublin cebularz with onion and poppy seeds, protected by the EU (participants bake their own cebularz). The price list is valid until 31 Dec 2026.
descriptions.warszawa_pge_narodowy: A guided tour behind the scenes of the National Stadium: dressing rooms, VIP area, the pitch.
descriptions.warszawa_legia_trasa: A tour of the Legia Warsaw stadium (dressing rooms, tunnel, pitch). The separate club museum is currently closed for renovation.
descriptions.warszawa_muzeum_powstania: A museum dedicated to the 1944 Warsaw Uprising - one of the most popular attractions in the city.
descriptions.warszawa_polin: A multimedia museum of the history of Polish Jews. On Thursdays admission to the permanent exhibition is free.
descriptions.warszawa_zoo: One of the oldest zoos in Poland, with over 5,000 animals, in the Praga district.
descriptions.warszawa_kopernik: An interactive science centre with permanent exhibitions and a planetarium.
descriptions.warszawa_hala_koszyki: A restored market hall from 1908, today a food hall with numerous restaurants and bars. Free entry, you pay for the food.
descriptions.warszawa_bazar_rozyckiego: The oldest surviving bazaar in Warsaw (since 1901), with the atmosphere of old Praga and local food. Free entry.
descriptions.warszawa_lazienki: The largest and most popular park in Warsaw, with the Chopin monument, pavilions and ponds. Entry to the park is free (only the palace interiors are paid).
descriptions.hamburg_st_michaelis: A baroque church and a symbol of Hamburg; entry to the church is free, the viewing tower is paid separately.
descriptions.hamburg_speicherstadtmuseum: A museum on the history of the Speicherstadt warehouse district - the trade in coffee, cocoa and spices.
descriptions.hamburg_imm: One of the largest maritime museums in the world, in the historic Kaispeicher B warehouse.
descriptions.hamburg_elbphilharmonie_plaza: A viewing point on the Elbphilharmonie terrace with a panorama of the port. The price is a booking fee for free admission (not a classic ticket).
descriptions.hamburg_hagenbeck: A historic zoo, one of the oldest in the world, with enclosures without bars. The Tropen-Aquarium is a separate ticket.
descriptions.hamburg_miniatur_wunderland: The world's largest model railway, with miniatures of cities around the world.
descriptions.munchen_fcbayern_erlebniswelt: The FC Bayern club museum combined with a tour of the Allianz Arena stadium (combo ticket).
descriptions.munchen_sayaq_adventure_tower: A climbing park on a tower structure in the Olympic Park with a viewing platform.
descriptions.munchen_jochen_schweizer_klettergarten: A high ropes course inside the Jochen Schweizer Arena near Munich. Starting price 'from' - the operator's website does not distinguish between adult and child.
descriptions.munchen_deutsches_museum: The largest museum of technology and science in Germany, on Museumsinsel.
descriptions.munchen_residenz: The former residence of the Bavarian Wittelsbach rulers - a museum and treasury (Schatzkammer), combined ticket.
descriptions.munchen_bmw_museum: A museum of the history of the BMW brand next to BMW Welt.
descriptions.munchen_schloss_nymphenburg: The summer palace of the Wittelsbachs - a combo ticket covering the palace, the Marstallmuseum and the Porzellanmuseum (summer price).
descriptions.munchen_frauenkirche: Entry to the south tower of the Cathedral of Our Lady, a symbol of Munich.
descriptions.munchen_skylift_olympiapark: A lift/viewing platform on the stands of the Olympic stadium.
descriptions.munchen_hellabrunn: The world's first geo-zoo, with about 19,000 animals.
descriptions.munchen_sealife: An aquarium in the centre of the Olympiapark.
descriptions.munchen_bavaria_filmstadt: A tour of the film sets of Bavaria Film studios in Grünwald, a combo ticket with a 4D cinema.
descriptions.munchen_bier_oktoberfest_museum: A museum of the history of beer and the Oktoberfest in the oldest residential house in Munich.
descriptions.munchen_viktualienmarkt: A famous daily food market in the centre of Munich. Free entry, you pay for the products.
descriptions.munchen_hofbrauhaus: Munich's most famous beer hall, operating since the 16th century. Free entry, you pay for what you consume.
descriptions.munchen_englischer_garten: One of the largest city parks in the world, known for the surfers on the Eisbachwelle. Free entry.
descriptions.munchen_westpark: A large city park in the west of Munich, created on the grounds of the 1983 International Horticultural Exhibition. Free entry.
descriptions.munchen_botanischer_garten: A botanical garden with about 200,000 plants, run by SNSB.
descriptions.koln_rheinenergiestadion: A guided tour of the 1. FC Köln stadium (dressing rooms, tunnel, stands).
descriptions.koln_claudius_therme: A thermal pool and sauna by the Rheinpark (weekday price).
descriptions.koln_dom: A Gothic cathedral, the symbol of Cologne, listed by UNESCO. New tourist fee from 1 July 2026.
descriptions.koln_museum_ludwig: A museum of modern and contemporary art (including Picasso).
descriptions.koln_wallraf_richartz: The largest collection of European painting (Middle Ages to Impressionism) in Cologne.
descriptions.koln_romisch_germanisches: The Roman-Germanic Museum. NOTE: the main building at Roncalliplatz is closed for renovation, the collection is temporarily exhibited in the Belgisches Haus.
descriptions.koln_ns_dokumentationszentrum: The documentation centre on the history of Nazism in Cologne, in the former Gestapo headquarters.
descriptions.koln_zoo: One of the largest zoos in Germany, with an aquarium. Online price is dynamic (adult 22.50-29.50 EUR; at the box office max 29.50 EUR) - the lowest confirmed 'from' price is shown.
descriptions.koln_triangle: A viewing point on the 29th floor with a panorama of the cathedral and the Rhine.
descriptions.koln_odysseum: A science experience centre with rotating temporary exhibitions. The price applies to the current exhibition ('Ramses & das Gold der Pharaonen') and may change with the next exhibition.
descriptions.koln_seilbahn: A seasonal (March to early November) cable car over the Rhine, connecting the Rheinpark with the Zoo. Price: Hin- und Rückfahrt ticket (as of 2026); a one-way ride costs 5.50 EUR.
descriptions.koln_schokoladenmuseum: A chocolate museum on the Rhine, from cocoa bean to bar, with a chocolate fountain (weekday price).
descriptions.koln_brewery_tour: A brewery tour with a tasting of Kölsch - Cologne's iconic beer. The price includes 3 Kölsch or 2 soft drinks.
descriptions.koln_flora_botanischer_garten: A historic botanical garden and landscape park from 1864. Free entry.
descriptions.wroclaw_panorama_raclawicka: A monumental panoramic painting (120×15 m) depicting the Battle of Racławice of 1794 (a branch of the National Museum in Wrocław).
descriptions.wroclaw_hydropolis: An interactive water education centre in an underground complex near the Market Square (weekday price).
descriptions.wroclaw_hala_targowa: A historic market hall from 1908 with local products. Free entry, the products are paid.
descriptions.wroclaw_ogrod_botaniczny: One of the oldest botanical gardens in Poland (founded 1811), with over 11,500 plant taxa (2025 season).
descriptions.wroclaw_park_szczytnicki: Wrocław's largest park, home of the Centennial Hall, the Japanese Garden and the Zoo. Free entry.
descriptions.wroclaw_wyspa_slodowa: A small, popular island on the Oder in the centre of Wrocław, a place for meeting and relaxing. Free entry.
descriptions.poznan_termy_maltanskie: A complex of thermal and sports pools by Lake Malta, with water slides and a sauna zone (price for 1 h in the Aquapark).
descriptions.poznan_brama_poznania: An interactive heritage interpretation centre on the Cybina river, with an exhibition on the history of Ostrów Tumski and the cathedral.
descriptions.poznan_nowe_zoo: The second largest zoo in Poland, with over 170 animal species. The price varies seasonally - given for weekdays in the March-October season.
descriptions.poznan_fotoplastykon: A 19th-century device for viewing 3D stereoscopic photographs, one of the few still working in Europe.
descriptions.poznan_rogalowe_muzeum: An interactive workshop/show on the history of the St. Martin's croissant (rogal świętomarciński), with a tasting. The price is given as 'from' - it may differ depending on the tour variant.
descriptions.poznan_palmiarnia: One of the largest palm houses in Europe, in Wilson Park, with collections of tropical plants and a small zoo (birds, fish). Price list valid from 1 Jan 2025.
descriptions.poznan_park_cytadela: Poznań's largest park, on the grounds of the former Prussian citadel. Entry to the park is free (the museums on its grounds are ticketed separately).

notes.essen_zeche_zollverein: 'from' price: the operator has 20+ tour variants (1 h from 12.50 €, 2 h from 16.50 €); the ermäßigt discount from 9.50 € (1 h) / from 13.50 € (2 h), but who qualifies for it on tours and the child/family discounts are not given - discounts possible, amount unconfirmed
notes.berlin_fernsehturm: 'from' price: dynamic prices depending on time and day (e.g. 24-29.50 € on one day); discounts (children 4-14 years etc.) exist, but their amount changes along with the price - discounts possible, amount unconfirmed, check at the box office/booking
notes.koln_zoo: 'from' price: online prices are dynamic (adult 22.50-29.50 €; child 10.50-15 €; reduced/senior 63+ 16.10-23 €) - discounts possible, the amount depends on the date
